text:
alex: CI red on staging smoke — integration suite failing against hosted API. errors in streaming + toolcall flows, 401s referencing KID mismatch. Anyone oncall or can grab logs?

maya: @alex can you paste the failing log lines and shard id? I can triage.

alex: shard=shard-7
CI run: nightly-smoke-2026-03-17
log:
```
http req POST /v1/stream -> 401 Unauthorized
WWW-Authenticate: Bearer error="invalid_token", error_description="kid not found: kid_abc123"
request-id=xyz-789
```
Also seeing rapid token rotations in auth-service metrics around 03:10Z.

ci-bot: smoke-tests/shard-7 FAILED (exit 1) — https://ci.internal/runs/4567 :rotating_light: 

jordan: probable token-key rotation mismatch between hosted auth and edge cache. @sam did we roll keyset earlier?

sam: we pushed keyset v2 to hosted-auth at 03:08Z, but edge-cache was on v1 until 03:12Z — looks like a race. odds this is a short window flake.

maya: willing to bisect. Can someone trigger a rerun for shard-7 so we can confirm determinism? If it passes, we bisect commits between 03:00-03:20.

alex: repro curl:
`curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_TOKEN" "https://hosted.redwood.ai/v1/stream?model=gpt-x" -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'`
Note toolcall flow also errors when streaming handshake fails (tool POSTs get 401).

jordan: I'll queue a rerun now (rerun id 7890). If it reproduces, maya can run `git bisect` on the infra changes and I'll coordinate a quick rollback plan.

maya: ack, will start bisect if rerun fails. tagging @security for KMS audit too.

alex: thanks — opened issue: REDWOOD-INT-2345, copying links to logs and rerun. Keep updates in this thread.

sam: FYI I'll patch edge-cache to validate keyset refresh ordering and add a short backoff; PR coming.

alex: :thumbsup:
